title: Email frame, checklist and unit quiz
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y9 lesson 19 (Email frame, checklist and unit quiz (portal worksheet and Forms quiz))
intro: Covers lessons 1 to 19 of At school. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: 'I like history because it is interesting':
questions.a: B) أُحِبُّ التَّارِيخَ لِأَنَّهُ مُمْتِعٌ. التَّارِيخ is masculine singular: لِأَنَّهُ مُمْتِعٌ.

questions.q: 'I prefer history to geography':
questions.a: A) أُفَضِّلُ التَّارِيخَ عَلَى الجُغْرَافِيَا. أُفَضِّلُ A عَلَى B = I prefer A to B.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the future?
questions.a: C) سَأَكْتُبُ الوَاجِبَ. سَـ + present = future: I will write the homework.

questions.q: 'She is tall and kind':
questions.a: B) هِيَ طَوِيلَةٌ وَلَطِيفَةٌ. Both adjectives agree with هِيَ: ـَة.

questions.q: From ف ت ح, which means 'opened'?
questions.a: B) مَفْتُوح. مَفْعُول pattern = passive participle: مَفْتُوح.

questions.q: 'Turn left' (to a male):
questions.a: B) اِنْعَطِفْ يَسَارًا. يَسَار = left; يَمِين = right.

questions.q: 'I will read' is:
questions.a: C) سَأَقْرَأُ. سَـ + present verb = future.

questions.q: 'The lessons are long' (الدُّرُوس):
questions.a: B) الدُّرُوسُ طَوِيلَةٌ. الدُّرُوس is a non-human plural: feminine singular طَوِيلَةٌ.

questions.q: Which connective shows a result?
How do you begin an email to a girl?
questions.a: B) عَزِيزَتِي مَرْيَمُ. عَزِيزَتِي is the feminine 'dear'.

questions.q: Bismillah. 'I will go': A) سَأَذْهَبُ B) ذَهَبْتُ
What does مَادَّة mean? A) subject B) school C) teacher
Bismillah. 'The subjects are useful': A) المَوَادُّ مُفِيدَةٌ B) المَوَادُّ مُفِيدُونَ
What does أُفَضِّلُ mean? A) I prefer B) I study C) I think
Bismillah. 'Therefore': A) لِذٰلِكَ B) لٰكِنَّ
Past 'I' verbs end in: A) ـتُ B) سَـ C) أَـ
Bismillah. Feminine of أَسْوَد? A) سَوْدَاء B) أَسْوَدَة
'He has' (for features) is: A) لَهُ B) لَهَا C) عِنْدِي
Bismillah. 'She has' (for features): A) لَهَا B) لَهُ
What does اِسْمُ الفَاعِلِ name? A) the doer B) the thing done C) the place

timeline.text: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ; عَزِيزِي أَحْمَدُ / عَزِيزَتِي مَرْيَمُ
My school and subjects, with opinions

arabic.text: عَزِيزِي يُوسُفُ، اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ، كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟ مَدْرَسَتِي الجَدِيدَةُ عَبْرَ الإِنْتَرْنِتِ. أَدْرُسُ ثَمَانِيَ مَوَادَّ، وَمَادَّتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ العُلُومُ لِأَنَّهَا مُمْتِعَةٌ، لٰكِنَّ الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ صَعْبَةٌ. أَمْسِ كَتَبْتُ تَقْرِيرًا عَنِ المَاءِ، وَغَدًا سَأَقْرَأُ سُورَةَ المُلْكِ فِي دَرْسِ القُرْآنِ. مَعَ تَحِيَّاتِي، آدَمُ
